title: 示例影片 · 从源文件到成片
author: Yang HENG

release.collection: 示例影片 · 从源文件到成片
release.description: 从源文件重建影片的示例；中文；纯 2D；仅旁白
release.comment: filmkit 的示例影片，供测试和演示；内容依据 ddwg-film 的 README
release.synopsis: 这部一分钟的短片演示一部影片怎样从源文件重建出来：脚本、参考录音和画面合成是源文件；构建先录下旁白，再拼成音轨、配上字幕，接着渲染画面、打包成片，全程不联网；最后每部成片都和源文件逐项核对。

editorial_intent.purpose: Show a first-time viewer, in spoken Chinese, how a narrated film is rebuilt from its tracked sources: complete thoughts, the stages in the order they run, and nothing the cited source does not state.

voice_performance.performance_intent: The DDWG narrator's reference, as ddwg-film selected it; clear, lively connected explanation; firm sentence endings; no theatrical delivery.
voice_performance.energy_curve: Curious opening, purposeful explanatory body, firmer decisions, settled coda.
voice_performance.pacing_profile: Ear-first copy spoken at the voice's native rate from the clear reference derived from the unmodified identity root. Speech is never time-stretched or pitch-shifted. No native pause inside a thought outlasts the declared inner cap, and each one lasts at least the floor of its punctuation, so a sentence end inside a thought is heard as a longer break than a clause mark and a clause mark as a longer one than a comma; a long run of speech takes a breath at the comma nearest its middle. Designed quiet separates complete thoughts and paragraphs, longer after longer ones, each thought boundary outlasts the longest pause inside its thought by at least a fifth, and the coda settles on its own longer pause after every thought; the remaining runtime opens the picture between paragraphs and chapters within declared bounds.

provider_notes.native: Identity-root ICL reference and fixed seed; natural punctuation only; no instruction tokens, pitch or tempo transform, or music.

timing_state: Unrecorded ear-first script; timing is derived after narration.

segments.title: 旁白、音轨和字幕
utterance_groups: 构建时，先照着脚本录下旁白。
再把录音拼成完整的音轨，按说话的时间配上字幕。
每段旁白都用固定的种子生成，所以每次重建，录出来的声音都一样。

segments.title: 核对成片
utterance_groups: 最后，每部成片都要和它的源文件逐项核对。
核对覆盖录音、音轨、字幕、画面和打包记录，每一项都必须和生成它的输入一致。
全部对得上，这次重建才算完成。
